name: Raise the Stakes (Combat)
body:
Luck turns in your favor as you go all in with a deadly stroke.

Prerequisite(s): Bestow Luck.

Benefit(s): You gain an extra daily use of either your Defiant Luck or Inexplicable Luck feat, which you must share with an ally. In addition, you can grant additional uses of your Inexplicable Luck to allies by expending one use of mythic power each time you wish to use an immediate action to Bestow Luck.
